```yaml
name: Claude Code Review

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]

jobs:
  claude:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check collaborator
        id: check_collab
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const { data: isCollaborator } = await github.repos.checkCollaborator({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              username: context.actor
            }).catch(() => null);
            return { is_collaborator: isCollaborator ? 'true' : 'false' };
          result-encoding: json

      - name: Run Claude Code
        if: ${{ steps.check_collab.outputs.is_collaborator == 'true' && (contains(github.event.issue.title, '@claude') || contains(github.event.issue.body, '@claude') || contains(github.event.comment.body || '', '@claude')) }}
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
        with:
          trigger_phrase: '@claude'
          allowed_non_write_users: ''
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          claude_code_oauth_token: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN }}
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
